A spot worth the drive

Barnes & Noble on a rainy Sunday

My daughter and I got rained out of a hike nearby one Sunday afternoon, so we ended up at Barnes & Noble instead, and it turned into a great hang. I grabbed a peppermint mocha from the big café, and the whole place took me right back to going to Borders with my parents when I was a kid.

It was busy and lively without feeling crowded. The kids' section was full of families reading and playing together, with plenty of toys alongside the books. When the weather wins, this is a pretty good plan B.

Night in

Puzzle and podcast night

Pick a 500-piece puzzle, put on a podcast or an audiobook, and see how far you get before bed. Leave it on the table all week and chip away at it. Bonus points for a puzzle of somewhere you'd rather be right now.
